summary: Resets the scroll offset field this[0x14C] to 0, then, when the max scroll value this[0x160] is non-zero and the display size this[0x154] cast to double is above 0.0, stores the CRTFtol-truncated display size as the new scroll offset. Called by sub_489D00 and UIScrollListUpdate during UI list refresh.

local_names.v1: max scroll value read from this[0x160]
local_names.v2: display size this[0x154] widened to double

operations.description: Unconditionally zero the scroll offset field this[83] (byte offset 0x14C) before any guard.
Load this[88] (byte offset 0x160) as v1 and require it non-zero; otherwise the scroll offset stays 0.
Read display size this[85] (byte offset 0x154), cast to int and then to double as v2.
Guard: only proceed when v2 is greater than 0.0; otherwise the scroll offset stays 0.
Call CRTFtol(v2) to truncate the display-size double to a long integer.
Store the truncation result into the scroll offset field this[83] (byte offset 0x14C).
Invoked by sub_489D00 and UIScrollListUpdate (0048A8D0) as part of list scrolling.
